cover.report_type: Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign Committee

_meta.notes: Single-page dissolution notice only - no Summary Page and no figures, despite the form's instruction to attach a final summary report. This form variant has no 'County Office' field; it asks instead for 'Date Committee Was Established', filled in as 3-12-10. Committee 'RICHARD SNELGROVE COUNTY COUNCIL'; candidate and secretary both Richard Snelgrove. Office_sought is left blank because the form prints no office field (the At-Large B seat comes from the clerk listing only). Signed 1-26-12; clerk RECEIVED stamp JAN 27 2012.
